mapper.select: SELECT id,source_channel,trigger_type,source_instance_hash,mapping_config_version,sync_window_from,sync_window_to,batch_status,reconciliation_status,governance_status,total_rows FROM t_import_batch WHERE ingest_method='API' ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_import_batch SET governance_status='SUPERSEDED',superseded_by_batch_id=CASE id WHEN #{row.oldId} THEN #{row.newerId} END,governance_reason=#{reason},governed_at=#{now},governed_by=#{actor} WHERE governance_status='ACTIVE' AND id IN #{row.oldId}

UPDATE t_import_batch SET governance_status='NO_CHANGE',governance_reason=#{reason},governed_at=#{now},governed_by=#{actor} WHERE governance_status='ACTIVE' AND ingest_method='API' AND batch_status='COMPLETED' AND total_rows=0 AND success_rows=0 AND failed_rows=0 AND reviewed_rows=0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_import_batch WHERE governance_status='ACTIVE'
